description: Check route availability, estimated one-minute usage, and remaining allowance before dialing. Calls in Central America, Europe, North America, and South America. Calls involving any non-US/Canadian number require a paid plan. Uses the verified caller ID and destination to price the route. Uses cached routing data or dialed prefixes without a paid lookup. Does not place a call, send a code, or reserve plan usage. Estimates expire and are rechecked before dialing.
